title: Haunted Gallery
corePromise: A cinematic 3D survival hunt where each player chooses whether to stay, hide, or risk moving to a connected room while Elias Voss and infected guests search the mansion museum.

session.birthdayRule: After twelve unique survivor seats are assigned, the one unselected guest is the birthday guest and opening victim. That guest is already inside.
session.soloRule: One human may select a survivor; CPUs fill every other active survivor seat.
session.loss: Every remaining survivor has escaped or become infected.

rooms.name: Grand Portrait Gallery
rooms.storyPurpose: The midnight unveiling and first bite happen here.
rooms.searchRisk: Frames and curtains create false movement and uncertain sightlines.

rooms.name: Sculpture Vault
rooms.storyPurpose: A dangerous shortcut around the central exhibition.
rooms.searchRisk: Statues make silhouettes difficult to read.

rooms.name: Archive Library
rooms.storyPurpose: Museum records reveal Elias has staged previous private unveilings.
rooms.searchRisk: Rolling shelves can trap a survivor who waits too long.

rooms.name: Conservation Lab
rooms.storyPurpose: Restoration notes explain that the camera flash interrupts the infection long enough to flee.
rooms.searchRisk: Metal carts and hanging canvas announce careless movement.

rooms.name: Curator's Study
rooms.storyPurpose: Personal records establish Elias Voss as the recurring Curator.
rooms.searchRisk: The Curator searches this room more thoroughly after its clue is found.

rooms.name: Sealed Exhibition Room
rooms.storyPurpose: The central hub offers the fastest routes and the greatest exposure.
rooms.searchRisk: Most paths cross here, increasing the chance of meeting a hunter.

rooms.name: Hall of Mirrors
rooms.storyPurpose: Reflections make camera timing and zombie identity uncertain.
rooms.searchRisk: A false reflection can reveal a hiding survivor when a hunter searches.

opening: Twelve active guests arrive by limousine; the unselected birthday guest is already inside the mansion museum.
An arriving guest who arranged the visit leads them in. Elias Voss welcomes the group.
At midnight Elias unveils a supposedly lost masterpiece. The painting is background story, not a supernatural trigger.
An active guest deliberately takes a normal birthday photograph with the working antique camera beside Elias and the birthday guest.
The flash unexpectedly freezes Elias. The group retreats, while the birthday guest remains to check on him.
Roughly five seconds later Elias bites the birthday guest. The single camera falls during the panic with its batteries intact.
If the camera moves to a side room before lockdown, show who picked it up and left it there. Keep its location and recharge state consistent.
The birthday guest turns into the first additional zombie. Panic and security lockdown start the survival hunt.

huntLoop.choiceWindow: Each living survivor privately chooses stay, move to one connected room, or hide at one of that room's two hiding places.
huntLoop.movement: Unreal animates chosen characters between rooms; movement is committed once the travel window starts.
huntLoop.uncertainty: Players know which people have visibly turned, but room destinations and hiding choices remain private.
huntLoop.hunterTurn: Elias and infected survivors select rooms to search. A survivor found without a successful escape or flash is bitten.
huntLoop.infection: A bitten survivor drops carried objects, becomes an infected hunter, and joins the next hunter turn.
huntLoop.camera: The carrier may deliberately take a photograph. Visible infected characters freeze for five seconds. The camera recharges for seven seconds.
huntLoop.cameraDrop: If the carrier is bitten, the camera falls at that exact room position and may be recovered later.
huntLoop.escape: A survivor reaching the exit during a safe travel window leaves alive. The carrier may escape with the camera or return to help others.

storyFlow.name: The Invitation
storyFlow.play: Twelve unique human/CPU survivor seats, the unselected birthday guest already inside, and limousine arrival of the active guests.

storyFlow.name: The Unveiling
storyFlow.play: Elias welcome, painting backdrop, deliberate birthday photo, five-second freeze, delayed bite, camera continuity and lockdown.

storyFlow.name: The Hunt
storyFlow.play: Stay, move and hide decisions; first infection; the camera is recovered; survivors learn the five-second stun by experience.

storyFlow.name: The Truth
storyFlow.play: Archive, lab and study clues explain the recurring unveilings without requiring every clue for escape.

storyFlow.name: The Last Run
storyFlow.play: Remaining survivors choose self-preservation or rescue, cross the central exhibition and attempt the final exit.

storyFlow.name: Aftermath
storyFlow.play: Show who escaped, who turned and where the camera ended. Elias remains the signature threat for future sessions.

hideRules.physicalRequirement: Every hiding point has a collision cover large enough to break direct sight and a visible in-world recess.
hideRules.choice: A survivor may enter only a hiding point in their current room.
hideRules.search: A hunter must choose a room and then a hiding location to check; entering the same room does not automatically expose every hidden survivor.
hideRules.repeatPressure: Using the same hiding place on consecutive hunt turns raises its search chance for CPUs and may expose an audio cue.
hideRules.exit: A hidden survivor must leave hiding before moving rooms.

implementedNow: two collision-backed hiding locations in every room
full story and room graph manifests
laterProduction: final MetaHuman likenesses and formal wardrobe

rescueAndPhoneMessages.objective: Recover the one camera, save as many living guests as possible, and escape alive.
rescueAndPhoneMessages.sos: Named private preset message to one living guest with verified room snapshot and timestamp; never shown to hunters.
rescueAndPhoneMessages.hunterKnowledge: Alive identities and public status, never live survivor rooms, hiding places, or SOS.
rescueAndPhoneMessages.scoring: Escape +100 personal/+100 team; verified rescue followed by escape +150 rescuer/+150 team; successful camera assist +50 photographer.
